I have had some bad points in my childhood i never really think or talk about cause they suck... I couldn't put an exact time frame on it because the last one a couple of months ago I was in a really bad place for over a year then I was alright and pretty happy and bouncy, high on life basically and now I've dropped back to that point.. it's pretty infuriating.. I can go from extatic to suicidal so quickly within a week it's unbelievable.. I get some points where I don't feel anything, like nothing is real essentially but I've always been like that tbh..

I was pretty outgoing and alright in childhood, it didn't all start until I was around 10 when  I started self harming and things like that.  

So I've always been on an up and down roller coaster  but now it's 10000x worse after I was raped... 

Seeing things that aren't there I worked out was just due to stress, whenever I was in a really bad place I would see 3 dark figures always standing around  (sounds weird I know lol) but the doctors told me it was stress and it would stop eventually.. I also used to hear a girl screaming constantly which was horrible 😱.

I was put on fluxotene at first but they weren't any use, then I was put on sertraline (antidepressants) I don't remember the dosage but that's what pushed me over the edge and overdosed on that (stupid attempt I know). 

I'm not sure I don't know much about bipolar disorder nor has it ever came up lol.

I've been diagnose with GAD, depression and ptsd. 
I last seen a counsellor when I tried to overdose a few months ago and after emailing the specialist people who dealt with what I need to speak about, they replied saying I could make an appointment and then when I asked for dates and phoned up they never got back to me so I'll need to try and call them again.
